o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish صو, from Proto-Turkic *sub..
From Arabic نَفْرَة (nafra), via Persian نفرت (nefrat).
From qalxana (“shield”) (dative) + bənzər (“similar”). Likely a calque of Russian щитови́дный (ščitovídnyj).
From Middle Mongol ᠨᠣᠭᠲᠤ (noɣtu); compare Mongolian ногт (nogt).
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish كوینمك (göynemek, göynümek), from Proto-Turkic *köń-. Cognate with Turkish göymek, göynemek, Turkmen köýmek.
Izafet II compound of ayı (“bear”) + soğanı (“onion”). Calque of Russian медвежий лук (medvežij luk).
